headlines.title: 崔东树：近期汽车行业利润下滑幅度仍较大 主流车企盈利压力仍将急剧增大
headlines.summary: 乘联分会崔东树发文称，锂电池出口价格从2024年14.29万元下降26%，到2025年的11.23万元，降21%。2026年10.5万元降11%，其中7月中国出口的电池均价10.60万元、同比下降3%，4-7月退税降低后的降价幅度较去年的改善明显。近期随着车市生产规模扩大，PPI上行，上游碳酸锂成本上升，锂电池出口价格持续下降，国内电池价格暴涨，车企不造电池的问题严重，车企利润可持续下滑。

headlines.title_en: Cui Dongshu: Recent Auto Industry Profit Declines Remain Significant, Mainstream Automakers Face Sharply Rising Profit Pressure
headlines.summary_en: Cui Dongshu of the CPCA said in a post that lithium battery export prices fell 26% from RMB 142,900 in 2024 to RMB 112,300 in 2025, down 21%, and to RMB 105,000 in 2026, down 11%. In July, the average export price of Chinese batteries was RMB 106,000, down 3% year-on-year, with the price decline after tax rebate reductions from April to July showing clear improvement over last year. Recently, as auto production scales up, PPI rises, upstream lithium carbonate costs increase, and lithium battery export prices keep falling, while domestic battery prices surge. The problem of automakers not building batteries is serious, and their profits continue to decline sustainably.

headlines.title_en: Morning news roundup
headlines.summary_en: The STAR 50 Index rose 3.45% in the morning session, with computing hardware and chip stocks strengthening collectively. The Hang Seng Index fell 0.4% at midday, while the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 0.2%; Zhipu gained nearly 9%, and Baidu rose over 6%. China's July industrial profits above designated size grew 11.2% year-on-year, and profits in the integrated circuit industry rose 18.5 times for January-July. Wang Yi met with U.S. Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns. A-share review reality: IPO tightening for unprofitable firms? Media citing insiders says it's not about blocking but improving quality. The Bank of Korea raised rates for a second consecutive meeting and sharply lifted growth forecasts for this year and next. Reports say Nvidia is acquiring Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, intensifying the battle for the AI 'middle layer'. Zhipu's new model 'Niulai' runs on 100,000 domestic chips, and SemiAnalysis comments 'Nvidia's moat faces another test'.

headlines.title: 王毅会见美国驻华大使庞德伟
headlines.summary: 8月26日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在京会见美国驻华大使庞德伟。王毅说，在两国元首领航掌舵下，双方正在推动构建中美建设性战略稳定关系。事实证明，改善发展中美关系，在相互尊重基础上和平共处，进而合作共赢，符合两国人民根本利益，符合国际社会共同期待。同时，中美关系仍面临各种风险挑战。双方应把两国元首达成的重要共识落到实处，聚焦积极议程，妥善管控分歧，为两国高层交往排除干扰、克服障碍，推动中美关系朝着稳定、健康、可持续的方向发展。

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi Meets with US Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns
headlines.summary_en: On August 26, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, met with U.S. Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns in Beijing. Wang Yi said that under the stewardship of the two heads of state, both sides are working to build a constructive, stable strategic relationship. Facts have proven that improving and developing China-U.S. relations, coexisting peacefully on the basis of mutual respect, and then achieving win-win cooperation serves the fundamental interests of both peoples and meets the common expectations of the international community. At the same time, the relationship still faces various risks and challenges. Both sides should implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state, focus on a positive agenda, properly manage differences, remove interference and overcome obstacles for high-level exchanges, and push the relationship toward stable, healthy, and sustainable development.

headlines.title_en: Lv Haiqi, Director of the National Bureau of Statistics Institute of Statistical Science, Interprets China's 2025 New Economic Development Momentum Index
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 27: Lu Haiqi, Director of the National Bureau of Statistics' Institute of Statistical Science, interpreted China's 2025 new economic momentum index. Calculations show the 2025 transformation and upgrading index stood at 156.8, up 22.7% year-on-year. headlines.title: 商务部回应美考虑对华额外加征7.5%关税
headlines.summary: 商务部27日举行例行新闻发布会，商务部新闻发言人黄玲在回应有关美国政府考虑对自中国进口商品额外加征7.5%关税的提问时说，美方以“产能过剩”为由对包括中国在内的16个经济体发起301调查，将经贸问题政治化，是典型的单边主义、保护主义行为，中方对此坚决反对。我们将继续密切关注并全面评估美方后续举措，并保留采取一切必要措施的权利。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce Responds to US Consideration of Additional 7.5% Tariffs on China
headlines.summary_en: At a routine press conference on the 27th, MOFCOM spokesperson Huang Ling, responding to a question about U.S. government considerations of imposing an additional 7.5% tariff on imports from China, said that the U.S., citing 'overcapacity,' launched a Section 301 investigation against 16 economies including China, politicizing trade issues in a typical act of unilateralism and protectionism, which China firmly opposes. We will continue to closely monitor and comprehensively assess subsequent U.S. actions and reserve the right to take all necessary measures. (Xinhua)

headlines.title_en: China's Three Major A-Share Indices All Rise Over 1%, Semiconductor and Computing Hardware Stocks Rally
headlines.summary_en: 1, Overall trend: The market strengthened throughout the day, with all three major indices up over 1% and the STAR 50 Index up nearly 4%. Advancers outnumbered decliners, with about 3,400 stocks rising across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing exchanges, and turnover at RMB 2.14 trillion. At the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.13%, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.5%, and the ChiNext rose 1.71%. 2, Sectors: Computing hardware, semiconductor chips, agriculture, and consumer electronics led gains, while banks, baijiu, gas, and film and television fell. 3, Hot concepts: Computing hardware stocks strengthened collectively, with Jinan Guoji, Hongchang Electronics, and Changfei Optical Fiber hitting limit-up. Semiconductor chip stocks surged, with Semiwise, Bright Power Semiconductor, and Onmicro all hitting 20cm limit-up. Agricultural stocks were active, with Xinsai, Xinnong Development, and Wanxiang Denong hitting limit-up. On the downside, photovoltaic equipment fell, with Sungrow Power down over 12%.

headlines.title: 知情人士回应“A股未盈利企业无法上市”：不封堵只提质
headlines.summary: 近日，有市场传言称，A股未盈利企业IPO申报全面收紧，港股同步受到影响。记者从知情人士处了解到，目前不存在未盈利企业一律无法上市的可能性，无论A股还是港股，都会继续向优质未盈利企业敞开大门，只是对未盈利企业的审核更为严格，要求企业具备更为明确的商业变现路径与业绩改善预期；对于亏损持续未见收窄、短期商业化落地难度较大，且并非细分行业绝对头部的企业，IPO审核尺度将更为严苛。（21世纪经济报道）

headlines.title_en: Insiders Respond to 'Unprofitable Companies Cannot List on A-Shares': No Blockage, Only Quality Improvement
headlines.summary_en: Recently, market rumors suggest that IPO applications from unprofitable A-share companies have been comprehensively tightened, with Hong Kong stocks similarly affected. A source with knowledge of the matter told reporters that there is currently no possibility of unprofitable companies being completely barred from listing; both A-shares and Hong Kong will continue to open their doors to high-quality unprofitable companies, but reviews will be stricter, requiring companies to have clearer commercial monetization paths and improved performance expectations. For companies with persistent losses that have not narrowed, difficulty in near-term commercialization, and who are not absolute leaders in their sub-sectors, IPO review standards will be more stringent. (21st Century Business Herald)
